title: AI Config
description: Configure AI service behavior and capabilities

wizard.title: AI Configuration Status
wizard.description: Check your AI feature configuration status
wizard.memoryWarningTip: All groups mode processes memory for all groups, which may consume more tokens

serviceSwitch.title: Enable AI Service
serviceSwitch.enabledDesc: AI service is enabled, users can use AI features
serviceSwitch.disabledDesc: Enable to allow users to use AI chat, search and other features

serviceProvider.title: Service Providers
serviceProvider.subtitle: Service Provider Configuration
serviceProvider.embeddingProviderDesc: Restart required after switching embedding provider
serviceProvider.embeddingProviderSwitched: Embedding provider switched to '{provider}', restart required
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingBaseUrlDesc: Specify OpenAI-compatible embedding API base URL, usually ends with /v1
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingApiKeyDesc: Specify OpenAI-compatible embedding API key, supports multiple keys
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingModelDesc: Specify embedding model name for text embedding processing

advancedSettings.title: Advanced Settings
advancedSettings.roundsHint: More rounds mean deeper thinking but more token consumption
advancedSettings.whitelistPlaceholder: Add user IDs (only these users can use AI)
advancedSettings.blacklistPlaceholder: Add user IDs (these users cannot use AI)

memorySettings.title: Memory Configuration
memorySettings.enabledDesc: Memory is enabled, AI will automatically record and retrieve conversation history
memorySettings.disabledDesc: When enabled, AI will be able to remember conversation history and respond based on memory
memorySettings.enableSystem2Desc: enable LLM node search memory, improve memory accuracy but increase latency
memorySettings.evalModeDesc: enable after LLM node graph is built, evaluation mode is for evaluation only

openaiConfig.title: OpenAI Configuration
openaiConfig.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the configuration '{name}'? This action cannot be undone.
openaiConfig.noConfig: Please select a configuration or create a new one
openaiConfig.noConfigDesc: Click "New Config" in the top right to create a new configuration file
openaiConfig.cannotDeleteLastConfig: Cannot delete the only config file. Please create another config first
openaiConfig.baseUrlTrailingSlashWarning: API Base URL must not end with /. Please remove the trailing slash
openaiConfig.apiKeyRequired: Please enter at least one API Key

providerConfig.title: Provider Configuration
providerConfig.highLevelTaskDesc: Complex reasoning, tool calling, etc. requiring strong model capability
providerConfig.lowLevelTaskDesc: Simple Q&A, quick response, etc. requiring basic model capability
providerConfig.setHighLevelSuccess: High level task config set to: {name}
providerConfig.setLowLevelSuccess: Low level task config set to: {name}
providerConfig.noActiveConfigWarning: High level or low level task has no active config file. Please select a config file below to enable AI service
providerConfig.noConfigFileWarning: Please click "New Config" in the top right to create a config file first, then assign it to high level and low level tasks

imageUnderstand.title: Image Understanding
imageUnderstand.providerDesc: When LLM model doesn't support images, this service converts images to text

voiceRecognition.title: Voice Recognition
voiceRecognition.description: Configure voice recognition (ASR) service provider for converting voice messages to text
voiceRecognition.providerDesc: Configure voice recognition (ASR) service provider for converting voice messages to text

documentExtract.title: Document Extraction
documentExtract.description: Configure document extraction service provider for converting PDF/Word/Excel to text
documentExtract.providerDesc: Configure document extraction service provider for converting PDF/Word/Excel to text

mcpTool.title: MCP Tool Association
mcpTool.selectToolDesc: Select a tool from configured MCP servers
mcpTool.noToolAssociatedDesc: Please add MCP servers and discover tools in the MCP Config page first
mcpTool.noMcpConfigsDesc: Please add MCP servers in the MCP Config page first
mcpTool.noToolsAvailable: No tools available for this MCP server

memeSettings.title: Meme Configuration
memeSettings.description: Configure meme collection, tagging and sending behavior
memeSettings.enableMemeDesc: Master switch, disabling stops all meme collection and sending
memeSettings.autoCollectDesc: Automatically listen to group chat images and store them
memeSettings.maxFileSizeDesc: Images larger than this will be ignored, memes are usually small
memeSettings.allowedMimeDesc: Only collect images of these MIME types
memeSettings.minWidthDesc: Images narrower than this will be ignored
memeSettings.minHeightDesc: Images shorter than this will be ignored
memeSettings.dailyCollectLimit: Daily Auto Collect Limit Per Group
memeSettings.dailyCollectLimitDesc: Maximum number of images auto-collected per group per day
memeSettings.vlmSemaphoreDesc: Maximum number of concurrent VLM tagging tasks
memeSettings.tagIntervalSecDesc: Minimum interval between two VLM tagging operations
memeSettings.nsfwThresholdDesc: Images with NSFW score above this threshold will be marked as rejected
memeSettings.sendCooldownSecDesc: Minimum interval between sending memes in the same session
memeSettings.recentExcludeCountDesc: Exclude the most recent N sent images when sending memes
